oneLine: AceVector files RHP for Rs 287 Cr fresh issue and IPO.
seller: Starfish I Pte. Ltd., Nexus India Direct Investments II, Nexus Opportunity Fund, Nexus Ventures III, SoftBank, Foxconn

sources.title: AceVector files RHP for Rs 287 Cr fresh issue, turns free cash flow positive in FY26
Snapdeal parent AceVector to launch IPO on September 25, cuts offer size; fresh issue at Rs 287 crore

synopsis: SoftBank-backed AceVector, parent company of Snapdeal and Unicommerce, has filed its red herring prospectus with SEBI for an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of Rs 287 crore and an offer for sale of up to 4.12 crore shares by existing shareholders. Promoter selling shareholder Starfish I Pte. Ltd., along with Nexus entities, SoftBank, and Foxconn, will participate in the OFS, while co-founders Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal will not participate. The fresh issue proceeds will be used to strengthen Snapdeal's technology infrastructure, invest in marketing and business development, pursue inorganic growth, and meet general corporate requirements. The IPO opens for subscription on September 25 and closes on September 29, with the anchor book opening on September 24. IIFL, CLSA, and Systematix Group are the book-running lead managers.
